items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: Hank Aaron, say hey kid, Willie Mays, you know, with a tape measure.

ctx.x: that waitress so and so and so. And at that particular time, you could hear a pin drop on a piece of cotton, and nothing but my voice rang out. So I walked on out. Ike didn't know how to walk out. He was glued in his shoes. He finally came out. So we got on an empty car, and we picked out a seat for ourselves, and the conductor got on and he says, "You boys will have to change your seats." We said, "Why? It's an empty train. There's no-one on here but us. Why do we have to change our seats?" He said, "Well, this…

so full of whiskey. He refuses to accept that. No sooner said than done. Here they come from both entrances. "All right, let's get off the train." I stand up, like Richard Pryor. "What's the charges, Officer?" Bam. Blackjack, right in the forehead. I ain't opening my mouth any more. I wasn't going to set the table for them to go any further. So we got out of the seats and started getting off the train, as ordered in the first place. So they handcuffed Ike to me, and they handcuffed Charlie singly and put him in…
